lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular spots is situated posterior to the gill slits, with spots arranged in approximately 10-12 distinct vertical columns and 6-8 horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular spots, forming a clear lattice-like pattern where the spots serve as high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-dark vertical gradient that defines the longitudinal structure of the integument.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 12 high-luminance spots of varying sizes, with higher density observed towards the anterior edge and the base of the fin mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, high-reflectance linear object is visible trailing from the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin. Small, dark, irregular patches suggestive of localized tissue damage are visible on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin displays a high density of smaller, more randomly distributed high-luminance spots compared to the structured grid on the main body.
